This is good — the editing flow itself does just what I want. I hit **Edit bookmark**, a panel slid in from the side, and I changed the title to "MDN JavaScript reference," typed my note "Review closures section," and typed "ref" and picked the suggested **reference** label just like before. When I hit **Save changes**, the panel closed and the card showed all three at once — new title, both labels, and my note sitting there on the card. Nothing got lost.

Both your assumptions feel right to me:

- Editing in a side panel is nice — the collection stays visible behind it, so I feel like I'm tweaking one item, not leaving the page.
- Having my note visible on the bookmark afterward is exactly what I wanted. That little note is the reason I'll remember why I saved something, so seeing it right there matters.

Two things I noticed are missing from that edit panel, though, and since this is my "fix up a bookmark" screen I'd want them here:

- I can change the title, but I couldn't change the **description** — the "Guides and references…" line. Sometimes the auto-filled description is off or too long and I'd want to reword it in my own terms.
- I also couldn't fix the **web address** itself. Once in a while I paste a link with junk on the end, or the page moves, and I'd want to correct the address on an existing bookmark rather than delete it and start over.

Can you add those two into this same edit panel? Everything else here is right.
